$meta.name: Ludo NX screen plan schema
$meta.note: What each field in SCREEN_PLANS/screens/<id>.json means. Every screen file carries every required field.

fields.id: Required. Kebab-case. Matches the filename and the index.json key.
fields.title: Required. Human name, as the owner would say it.
fields.type: Required. hub | popup | takeover | drawer | overlay | component | transition | system. Bible 4.1 allows only hub, popup and takeover as screens; the others are pieces that live inside one.
fields.status: Required. missing | rebuild | polish | review | done. Only the owner sets done.
fields.assignee: Required. any | claude | owner. Gemini may take 'any'.
fields.one_line: Required. What this screen is for, in one sentence.
fields.bible_sections: Required. The bible sections that govern it. Read them before building.
fields.specs: Optional. Extra spec documents that govern this screen.
fields.files: Required. prefab, builder, script, test_menu. Where the work lands. A path that does not exist yet is the path to create.
fields.depends_on: Required (may be empty). Screen ids or specs that must be done first.
fields.opens_from: Required. How the player gets here.
fields.opens: Required. What this screen can open.
fields.gaps: Only for status rebuild/polish. What is wrong with what exists today.
fields.anatomy: Required. Ordered list of zones, top to bottom. Each has 'zone' and 'spec'. This is the layout.
fields.components: Required. Bible section 5 components used, quoted by number.
fields.copy: Required. Every string on the screen, keyed. Live text only - never baked.
fields.states: Required. Every state the screen can be in, including empty, loading and error.
fields.motion: Required. Timings, all from tokens.json motion.
fields.data: Required. What the screen reads, and from where. Says where demo data must be replaced by server data.
fields.assets_needed: Required (may be empty). Each: name, path, size, who (owner | generated | exists), prompt.
fields.deviations: Required (may be empty). Approved departures from the bible, with who approved and when. Anything not listed here is not approved.
fields.do_not: Required. The mistakes that have already been made on this screen or one like it.
fields.acceptance: Required. Tick every line before reporting done. This is on top of bible section 11.
fields.steps: Required. The build order. Follow it.
fields.prompt: Required. The paste-to-agent brief. Self-contained enough to start from, and points at this file for the detail.
